text: Hi! I'm Sara. I live in Turin and work at Fiat as a data analyst.
Remember that I'm allergic to peanuts.
My manager is Paolo Ferri and the quarterly report deadline is 20 March.
The weather is lovely today, finally some sun.
Quick update: I just moved to Milan last weekend.
Actually, the quarterly report deadline moved to 27 March.
My new manager is Giulia Conti.
I'm presenting the report at the Lisbon offsite on 2 April.
